items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Tex was in the band. Al Klink, Willie Schwartz, Hal McIntyre.

ctx.x: No kidding. And was Tex Benecke?
Tex was in the band. Al Klink, Willie Schwartz, Hal McIntyre. The drummer was Maurice Purtill, the bass player was Rolly Bundock. He was replaced by Trigger Alpert. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
